incident-bot: ALERT fired — service="inference-api.prod" metric=p99_latency window=15m value=1240ms (SLO burn 18%) PagerDuty incident PD-34921 created

pagerduty: page PD-34921 -> oncall (tanvi) — urgent: p99 latency spike

tanvi: Acked PD-34921. I’m on it, pulling traces and recent deploys.

mike: I can help, waking infra dashboards. Any obvious traffic shift?

sara: saw a canary rollout to eu-west ~8m ago — maybe cold-starts + batch growth.

jane: linking perf trace and flame: https://internal/trace/PD-34921 (short) — large KV cache miss burst around 11:23

incident-bot: Additional signals: kv_cache_miss_rate ↑ 42% ; avg_batch_size ↑ 2.1x ; gpu_util ~78% ; queue_depth up 3x

tanvi: immediate plan: 1) route small % traffic to fallback model variant 2) warm KV cache 3) watch p95/p99 — roll back if errors spike. Can infra do a fast route flip?

mike: executing routing cmd now:
```
redwood route set inference-api --variant fallback-small --percent 25 --reason "p99 mitigation"
```

mike: command applied. routing change propagated to edge in ~30s :ok_hand:

jane: seeing p95 drop already, p99 trending down from 1240 -> 860 -> 640ms in last 2 min

tanvi: good. Can we warm KV? Suggest prefetch top hot keys and increase cache ttl briefly. Ops, can you run the warming job?

sara: kicking cache-warm job: `scripts/warm_kv --service inference-api --duration 5m` — started.

mike: also increased per-instance concurrency by +1 to relieve queueing (small change). Watch memory.

jane: customer impact check: embeddings heavy apps show tail blips, ~3-5% requests >2s for last 10m. Not widespread, but flagging to customer success.

tanvi: noted — notify CS with short blurb. If p99 remains >900ms after 10m, escalate PD auto-escalation.

incident-bot: PD-34921 status updated: acknowledged by tanvi, responders: tanvi, mike, sara, jane

mike: p99 now 480ms and stable for 60s. p95 ~110ms. Looks like routing + warm fixed the hot path.

tanvi: nice work. Keep monitoring 15m window. I’ll prepare a short incident note and handoff to next oncall in 20m.

sara: left a note in the runbook: investigate canary rollout concurrency and cache priming for gradual deploys.

jane: adding trace + quick graphs to PD ticket.

tanvi: handing off in 20m to night rotation @mike. If anyone sees resurgence, re-open PD and ping. :thumbsup: 

mike: ack — will take over after handoff. Good catch everyone.

incident-bot: PD-34921 still open — last update 28s ago. Remember to close when resolved.
